ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :system.record_status = 'INSERT' THEN
 select count(*) into counter from valid_elig_procs
 where curr_donation_type = :vep_block.curr_donation_type and
 procedure_code = :vep_block.procedure_code and
 prev_procedure_code = :vep_block.prev_procedure_code ;
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05',
 :vep_block.curr_donation_type||','||
 :vep_block.procedure_code||','|| 
 :vep_block.prev_procedure_code||
 ',','C',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
chk boolean;
begin
 if :ctrl_block.curr_donation_type is null
 then
 if :ctrl_block.procedure_code is null 
 then
 null;
 else 
 set_block_property('vep_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'procedure_code = :ctrl_block.procedure_code');
 end if;
 else 
 if :ctrl_block.procedure_code is null 
 then
 set_block_property('vep_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'curr_donation_type = :ctrl_block.curr_donation_type'); 
 else 
 set_block_property('vep_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'curr_donation_type = :ctrl_block.curr_donation_type 
 and procedure_code = :ctrl_block.procedure_code');
 end if;
 end if; 
 go_block('vep_block');
 execute_query;
 set_block_property('vep_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,' ');
 go_block('vep_block');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.CURR_DONATION_TYPE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.curr_donation_type',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.PROCEDURE_CODE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.procedure_code',action);
 end if;
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_curr_proc',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_curr_don',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_curr_proc',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_curr_don',NAVIGABLE,property_false);

 end if; 
END;
